name: Tool — MCP with agent Entra identity
summary: MCPTool with authType='AgenticIdentity' bound to the agent's own identity rather than the project's.
description: An MCP tool with per-agent managed identity authenticates the Prompt Agent to an MCP server using an agent-scoped identity while the orchestrator model is `{connection}/{deployment}`. This narrows tool-server permissions compared with sharing the project identity.
notes:
Not yet confirmed against Foundry for per-agent managed-identity MCP auth. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/mcp-authentication. See `test.py` for the `MCP_SERVER_URL_AGENT_IDENTITY` probe.

MCP is on the official BYOM-supported tools list, but this identity mode still needs a live server configured in the canary environment.
